boundary_source: fixed observed upstream routed state per sample
profile_interval: rmse <= 1.10 * rmse_min over the alpha grid

claims_scope.single_sample: algebraic under-determination of ONE equation with fixed C_in and two unknowns (k, S)
claims_scope.pooled: equal-weight 120-sample SSE with a shared alpha and shared S and a fixed observed upstream state
claims_scope.planar_markers: model median parameters drawn for orientation only; they are descriptive markers, not fitted network operating points
claims_scope.sensitivity_thresholds: 10% RMSE inflation used for the reported interval; no 5%/20% sensitivity is claimed

finding: A single concentration observation cannot identify (k, S) jointly: the per-sample objective has an exact zero valley S = S_diag + dC (k - k_emp), so the per-sample profile SSE is identically flat. This is an algebraic fact under fixed C_in, not a statistical likelihood. Pooling the samples with a uniform k-scale and source leaves the profile shallow: RMSE changes only from 0.0343 to 0.0364 mol/m3 across the k-scale interval [0.01, 1]. Markers on the pooled plane are descriptive medians, not network operating points.
